name: Hamilton Marketplace
summary: Hamilton Marketplace is a community-focused shopping center in Novato anchored by Safeway and featuring a strong mix of fast-casual dining, wellness services, and everyday conveniences. The center caters to Marin County's health-conscious residents with tenants like Nekter Juice, Massage Heights, and Sutter Walk-In Care alongside popular eateries and essential services.
demographics: Hamilton Marketplace serves the affluent Novato community in Marin County, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals with household incomes typically ranging from $100,000 to $200,000+. The primary trade area draws from North Bay residents seeking convenient neighborhood shopping, with a customer base skewing toward health-conscious, educated consumers aged 35-65. The center's tenant mix of organic grocers, juice bars, and wellness services reflects the area's preference for quality lifestyle amenities and premium food options typical of Marin County's demographic profile.
description: Hamilton Marketplace is a vibrant community shopping destination located in Novato, California, serving the North Bay area with a carefully curated mix of essential services and lifestyle retailers. Anchored by Safeway, the center has evolved into a neighborhood hub featuring an impressive array of dining options including Super Duper Burgers, Teriyaki Madness, World Famous Hot Boys Chicken, Sourdough & Co., and the artisan Rustic Bakery. Health and wellness are central to the marketplace's identity, with tenants like Massage Heights, Nekter Juice, Sutter Walk-In Care, and the upcoming X·Core Studio fitness facility catering to Marin County's health-conscious residents. The center also provides convenient everyday services through Wells Fargo banking, Pet Food Express, and the beloved Peet's Coffee & Tea, creating a one-stop destination for the community. With its open-air design and accessible location at 5800 Nave Drive, Hamilton Marketplace maintains extended hours seven days a week, making it a convenient gathering place for Novato families and professionals seeking quality shopping and dining experiences.
